bundlePurpose: Supply the two original LONG narrative passages required to complete provisional Forms 5 and 6.
copyrightBasis: No source passage is used. Both bundles are original and receive cross-bank rather than source-passage similarity review.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: A student oral historian interviewing a retired bus driver
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Begin with dependence on prepared questions; introduce a marked route map that does not fit the script; follow the evidence into an unwritten operating practice; document the story; conclude that attentive follow-up reveals what formal records omit.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: A novice kayaker learning to cross a river current
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Begin with confidence based on flat-water practice; let moving water expose the weakness of direct force; learn to use angle and a fixed landmark; complete the crossing; conclude that progress can require aiming somewhere other than the visible destination.
